items.headline: Interim Rick Stockstill cherishes gritty first win, ending FSU's road skid
items.description: Rick Stockstill won his first game as interim coach as Florida State ended an almost three-year drought on the road with a 31-24 victory at Boston College.

items.headline: Florida State breaks 2-year road losing streak -- how'd it get so bad?
items.description: Florida State's victory over Boston College was its first win on the road since November 2023.

items.headline: Thomas runs for 2 TDs; FSU beats BC 31-24 to make interim coach Rick Stockstill a winner in 1st game
items.description: — Amari Thomas ran for two touchdowns, his second an 11-yarder to put Florida State ahead late in the fourth quarter, and the Seminoles beat Boston College 31-24 on Saturday to make interim coach Rick Stockstill a winner in his first game.
